brief: We want to reach 10,000 young gamers in Kenya to promote our low-latency 5G Home Internet and MobiPlay gaming packages. Looking for a mix of university esports teams, community gaming dens, and high-energy streamers across Nairobi and Eldoret.
target_audience: 16-25 urban youth, university students, and grassroots mobile/console gamers

brief: Energizing grassroots competitive fighting game tournaments (Tekken 8) and mobile COD tournaments with high-intensity brand activations, campus shoutouts, and creator-led community derbies.
target_audience: 18-28 competitive esports athletes and fighting game fans
